crossRefs.note: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

translations.web: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”
translations.bsb: “Whose daughter are you?” he asked. “Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
translations.kjv: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
translations.asv: and said, Whose daughter art thou? Tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
